allocation: fixed slots min(0.25, 1/K); unused slots cash
cash_rule: no positive qualified score means cash
contamination_notes: Frontier-A through Frontier-J development evidence is already observed. Frontier-K is repeated development research, not a fresh holdout. 2023+ remains excluded from selection.
cost_hypothesis: weekly rebalance, sparse top-five books, and cash on absent state should limit unnecessary turnover; fixed cost ladder evaluated without post-result retuning
failure_mode: single-edge noise dominates or duplicates positive-edge shedding
falsifier: rotate strongest-peer detachment across eligible identities
primitive: Quantiacs daily OHLCV and historical is_liquid only
selection: positive scores, top-K, deterministic label tie breaks
selection_objective: minimum research/dev Sharpe across 0.04/0.08/0.12 ATR cost; then worst DD, lower turnover, id
source_notes: Fresh implementation only after this preregistration; no Frontier-K returns observed before freeze.
stop_rule: freeze if matched ablation or destructive falsifier matches/beats canonical parent, or if every valid base cell is below fixed 1.0 development floor; do not invert or retune after observing failure
thesis: Weakening of an asset's single strongest residual peer during market fragmentation captures local detachment more directly than mean centrality.
timing: completed daily bars only; every graph/state estimate uses trailing windows and fixed historical lag
validation: 2023-2024 remains untouched during development selection; 2025+ diagnostic/live evidence never drives mutation
